name: Order or judgment brief
description: Pulls the court, case number, bench, outcome, directions and next date out of an order or judgment and writes a cited brief for the team.

fields.label: Court
fields.question: Which court or tribunal passed this order?

fields.label: Case number
fields.question: What is the case number or CNR?

fields.label: Date
fields.question: On what date was the order passed?

fields.label: Bench
fields.question: Which judge or judges passed the order?

fields.label: Outcome
fields.question: What did the court decide or order?

fields.label: Directions
fields.question: What directions or conditions did the court give?

fields.label: Next date
fields.question: When is the matter listed next, if at all?

steps.title: Write the brief
steps.instructions: Write a brief of this order for the client team: one short paragraph on what was decided, then a list of the directions and conditions, any deadlines or the next date, and what our team needs to do next.

steps.title: Save the brief as a draft
